title: EvalJobConfig
description: Configuration for evaluating a served model

model_name.description: Model name as registered in the serving endpoint

dataset.description: Path to test dataset (JSONL with messages + ground truth fields)

max_samples.description: Maximum number of samples to evaluate

judge_model.description: LLM for subjective quality judging (e.g. openai/gpt-4o-mini)

accuracy_fields.description: Fields to compute exact-match accuracy on (parsed from model response)
